caption: Craco ghost town, Craco
composition: Abandoned hilltown cascading down a clay spur above the calanchi · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From across the valley, the camera takes in the ghost town of Craco crowding its bare clay spur in the bright 13:23 midday sun. Hundreds of roofless stone shells cascade down the slopes left and right, their empty windows and broken walls glowing pale against the deep blue sky. Below the town, the eroded gullies of the calanchi badlands carve grey ridges through the valley, with distant blue mountains closing the horizon.
alt_text: AI-generated artistic interpretation of Craco under midday light
